Lady of the Duke of Jingling's state
Chief Village Lady of Duxiang in Shangyu

label.en: Consort to the Qi heir apparent
Consort to the Prince of Nan commandery
Grand consort to the imperial grandson's heir
Consort to the Prince of Nan commandery
Consort to the heir apparent of the imperial grandson

Lady of the Marquis of Xichang

units.zh: 南齊書卷二十‧列傳第一
units.en: Book of the Southern Qi, Volume 20 — Biographies 1
units.literal: Book of the Southern Qi, Volume 20 — Biographies 1

units.zh: 六宮位號，漢、魏以來，因襲增置，世不同矣。
units.en: Palace ranks in the six inner quarters, from Han and Wei on, were carried forward and added to—no two reigns alike.
units.literal: The ranks of the six palaces, from Han and Wei onward, were inherited and augmented; each age differed.

units.zh: 建元元年，有司奏置貴嬪、夫人、貴人爲三夫人，脩華、脩儀、脩容、淑妃、淑媛、淑儀、婕妤、容華、充華爲九嬪，美人、中才人、才人爲散職。
units.en: In the first year of Jianyuan the relevant offices proposed the Three Ladies—Noble Consort, Lady, and Honored Person—and the Nine Consorts: Cultivated Elegance, Cultivated Comportment, Cultivated Bearing, Pure Consort, Pure Lady, Pure Rite, Talented Lady, Radiant Splendor, and Fulfilling Splendor, with Beauty, Middle Talent, and Talent as unattached offices.
units.literal: the first year of Jianyuan: the relevant offices memorialized establishing Noble Consort, Lady, and Honored Person as the Three Ladies; Cultivated Elegance, Cultivated Comportment, Cultivated Bearing, Pure Consort, Pure Lady, Pure Rite, Talented Lady, Radiant Splendor, and Fulfilling Splendor as the Nine Consorts; and Beauty, Middle Talent, and Talent as miscellaneous posts.

units.zh: 永明元年，有司奏貴妃、淑妃竝加金章紫綬，佩于窴玉。
units.en: In the first year of Yongming the relevant offices proposed that Honored Consort and Pure Consort alike receive gold seals and purple cords and wear Khotan jade pendants.
units.literal: Yongming year 1: the relevant offices memorialized that Honored Consort and Pure Consort alike should receive gold seals and purple cords and wear Khotan jade.

units.zh: 淑妃舊擬九棘，以淑爲溫恭之稱，妃爲亞后之名，進同貴妃，以比三司。
units.en: Pure Consort had once been equated with the Nine Ministers; shu denotes warmth and deference, fei the title of one who stands below the empress—she was raised to Honored Consort's level, on a par with the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: Pure Consort had formerly been ranked with the Nine Thorns; as shu means gentle and deferential and fei is the name for one who stands next to the empress, she was advanced to match Honored Consort and compared to the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 夫人之號，不殊蕃國。
units.en: The title Lady differed in no way from titles used in feudatory states.
units.literal: The title Lady was not different from that of feudatory states.

units.zh: 降淑媛以比九卿。
units.en: Pure Lady was demoted to rank with the Nine Ministers.
units.literal: Pure Lady was lowered to compare with the Nine Ministers.

units.zh: 七年，復置昭容，位在九嬪。
units.en: In year 7 Shining Countenance was reinstated, with standing among the Nine Consorts.
units.literal: Year 7: Shining Countenance was restored, her place among the Nine Consorts.

units.zh: 建元三年，太子宮置三內職，良娣比開國侯，保林比五等侯，才人比駙馬都尉。
units.en: In the third year of Jianyuan the crown prince's household set up three inner offices: Lady of Excellence, equal to a founding marquis; Guardian of the Grove, to a fifth-rank marquis; and Talented Lady, to the commandant of horses for imperial sons-in-law.
units.literal: the third year of Jianyuan: the crown prince's palace established three inner offices—Lady of Excellence ranked with a marquis who founds a state, Guardian of the Grove with a fifth-rank marquis, and Talented Lady with the commandant of horses for the emperor's sons-in-law.

units.zh: 宣孝陳皇后諱道止，臨淮東陽人，魏司徒陳矯後。
units.en: Empress Xuanxiao Chen Daozhi came from Dongyang in Linhuai commandery and was descended from Chen Jiao, minister of works of Wei.
units.literal: Empress Xuanxiao of the Chen clan, taboo name Daozhi, was a native of Dongyang in Linhuai and a descendant of Chen Jiao, minister of works of Wei.

units.zh: 父肇之，郡孝廉。
units.en: Her father Chen Zhaozhi had been a commandery filial-and-incorrupt nominee.
units.literal: Her father Chen Zhaozhi was a commandery filial and incorrupt candidate.

units.zh: 后少家貧，勤織作，家人矜其勞，或止之，后終不改。
units.en: The family was poor in her girlhood, and she wove and worked without rest. Relatives pitied her toil and tried to make her stop; she never changed her ways.
units.literal: In youth the empress's family was poor; she diligently wove and worked. Her kin took pity on her labor and sometimes tried to stop her, but the empress never changed.

units.zh: 嫁于宣帝，庶生衡陽元王道度、始安貞王道生，后生太祖。
units.en: She married Emperor Xuan. By concubines he already had Prince Daodu of Hengyang and Prince Daosheng of Shi'an; afterward she bore Xiao Daocheng, the Grand Ancestor.
units.literal: She married Emperor Xuan; Prince Daodu of Hengyang and Prince Daosheng of Shi'an were secondary-born (by concubines); afterward she bore the Grand Ancestor.

units.zh: 太祖年二歲，乳人乏乳，后夢人以兩甌麻粥與之，覺而乳大出，異而說之。
units.en: When Xiao Daocheng was two, his wet nurse could not supply enough milk. The empress dreamed that someone handed her two bowls of hemp porridge; she awoke to find her milk abundant, and she wondered at the omen.
units.literal: When the Grand Ancestor was two years old, his wet nurse had insufficient milk. The empress dreamed that someone gave her two bowls of hemp porridge; when she awoke her milk flowed freely—she marveled and spoke of it.

units.zh: 宣帝從任在外，后常留家治事教子孫。
units.en: Emperor Xuan was posted away from home while the empress stayed behind to run the household and instruct the children and grandchildren.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan was away on assignment; the empress often remained at home to manage affairs and teach the children and grandchildren.

units.zh: 有相者謂后曰：「夫人有貴子而不見也。」
units.en: A physiognomist told the empress, "My lady has a son of great rank, yet I have not laid eyes on him."
units.literal: A physiognomist told the empress: "My lady has an eminent son, but I have not seen him."

units.zh: 后歎曰：「我三兒誰當應之。」
units.en: She sighed. "I have three sons—which of them can it be?"
units.literal: The empress sighed and said: "Which of my three sons should it be?"

units.zh: 呼太祖小字曰：「正應是汝耳。」
units.en: She called the Grand Ancestor by his childhood name and said, "It must be you."
units.literal: She called the Grand Ancestor by his childhood name and said: "It must be you after all."

units.zh: 宣帝殂後，后親自執勤，婢使有過誤，恕不問也。
units.en: After Emperor Xuan's death she herself saw to the work of the household; when maidservants blundered, she pardoned them without question.
units.literal: After Emperor Xuan died, the empress personally took charge of labor; when maidservants erred, she forgave them and did not inquire.

units.zh: 太祖雖從官，而家業本貧，爲建康令時，高宗等冬月猶無縑纊，而奉膳甚厚，后每撤去兼肉，曰：「於我過足矣。」
units.en: Though Xiao Daocheng held office, the family had always been poor. When he was magistrate of Jiankang, Gaozong and the others still went without padded silk in winter, while the food sent in was lavish—the empress would remove the extra meat and say, "For me this is already too much."
units.literal: Though the Grand Ancestor held office, the family estate was originally poor; when he was magistrate of Jiankang, Gaozong and the others in winter still lacked silk padding, yet the meals sent were very rich—the empress each time removed the extra meat and said: "For me this is more than enough."

units.zh: 殂于縣舍，年七十三。
units.en: She died in the magistrate's quarters, aged seventy-three.
units.literal: She died at the magistrate's quarters, age seventy-three.

units.zh: 昇明三年，追贈竟陵公國太夫人，蜜印，畫青綬，祠以太牢。
units.en: In Shengming year 3 she was posthumously enfeoffed Grand Lady of the Duke of Jingling's state, with honey seal and painted green cord, and honored with the great offering.
units.literal: Shengming year 3: posthumous enfeoffment as Grand Lady of the state of the Duke of Jingling, with honey seal and painted green cord; sacrifice with the great offering.

units.zh: 建元元年，追尊孝皇后。
units.en: In the first year of Jianyuan she was posthumously honored as Empress Xiao.
units.literal: the first year of Jianyuan: posthumous elevation as Empress Xiao.

units.zh: 贈外祖父肇之金紫光祿大夫，諡曰敬侯。
units.en: His maternal grandfather Chen Zhaozhi was made household minister with the purple-gold seal and posthumously titled Marquis Jing.
units.literal: Her maternal grandfather Zhao was given the post of household minister with the purple-gold seal and posthumous title Marquis Jing.

units.zh: 后母胡氏為永昌縣靖君。
units.en: Her mother, née Hu, was made Village Lady Jing of Yongchang county.
units.literal: The empress's mother, the Hu clan, was made Village Lady Jing of Yongchang county.

units.zh: 高昭劉皇后諱智容，廣陵人也。
units.en: Empress Gaozhao Liu Zhirong came from Guangling.
units.literal: Empress Gaozhao of the Liu clan, taboo name Zhirong, was a native of Guangling.

units.zh: 祖玄之，父壽之，竝員外郎。
units.en: Her grandfather Liu Xuanzhi and father Liu Shouzhi had both served as supernumerary gentlemen.
units.literal: Her grandfather Xuanzhi and father Shouzhi were both supernumerary gentlemen.

units.zh: 后母桓氏夢吞玉勝生后，時有紫光滿室，以告壽之，壽之曰：「恨非是男。」
units.en: The empress's mother, née Huan, dreamed she swallowed a jade ornament when bearing her; purple light filled the room. She told Liu Shouzhi, who said, "I regret it was not a boy."
units.literal: The empress's mother, the Huan clan, dreamed she swallowed a jade hair ornament when bearing the empress; at that time purple light filled the room. She told Liu Shouzhi, and Shouzhi said, "I regret it was not a boy."

units.zh: 桓曰：「雖女，亦足興家矣。」
units.en: Huan replied, "Though a girl, she is enough to raise the family."
units.literal: Huan said, "Though a girl, she is enough to raise the family."

units.zh: 后每寢臥，家人常見上如有雲氣焉。
units.en: Whenever she slept, her family often saw cloudlike vapor above her.
units.literal: Whenever the empress slept, her family often saw above her something like cloud vapor.

units.zh: 年十餘歲，歸太祖，嚴正有禮法，家庭肅然。
units.en: In her teens she entered the Grand Ancestor's household; stern, correct, and observant of ritual, she kept the family in awe.
units.literal: In her teens she went to the Grand Ancestor's household; stern, correct, and observant of ritual, the family was awed into order.

units.zh: 宋泰豫元年殂，年五十。
units.en: In the first year of Taiyu of Song she died, aged fifty.
units.literal: In the first year of Taiyu of Song she died, aged fifty.

units.zh: 歸葬宣帝墓側，今泰安陵也。
units.en: She was buried beside Emperor Xuan's tomb, at what is now Taian Mausoleum.
units.literal: She was buried beside Emperor Xuan's tomb—what is now Taian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 門生王清與墓工始下鍤，有白兔跳起，尋之不得，及墳成，兔還栖其上。
units.en: When her student Wang Qing and the grave workers first dug, a white hare leaped up; they searched in vain, and when the mound was finished the hare returned to nest on it.
units.literal: When her student Wang Qing and the grave workers first struck the spade, a white hare leaped up; they searched but could not find it, and when the mound was finished the hare returned and nested upon it.

units.zh: 昇明二年，贈竟陵公國夫人。
units.en: In Shengming year 2 she was posthumously made Lady of the Duke of Jingling's state.
units.literal: In the second year of Shengming she was posthumously given the title Lady of the Duke of Jingling's state.

units.zh: 三年，贈齊國妃，印綬如太妃。
units.en: In year 3 she was made princess consort of Qi, with seals and cords like a grand consort.
units.literal: In the third year she was made Princess Consort of Qi, with seals and cords like a grand consort.

units.zh: 建元元年，尊諡昭皇后。
units.en: In the first year of Jianyuan she was posthumously honored as Empress Zhao.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan she was honored with the posthumous title Empress Zhao.

units.zh: 三年，贈后父金紫光祿大夫，母桓氏上〔虞〕都鄉君；
units.en: In year 3 her father was made household minister with the purple-gold seal, and her mother, née Huan, Chief Village Lady of Duxiang in Shangyu;
units.literal: In the third year her father was given the post of household minister with the purple-gold seal; her mother, the Huan clan, was made Chief Village Lady of Duxiang in Shangyu;

units.zh: 壽之子興道司徒屬，文蔚豫章內史，義徽光祿大夫，義倫通直郎。
units.en: Shouzhi's sons Xingdao, clerk of the minister of works; Wenwei, interior secretary of Yuzhang; Yihui, household minister; and Yilun, regular attendant in the transmission office.
units.literal: Shouzhi's sons Xingdao, a clerk of the minister of works, Wenwei, interior secretary of Yuzhang, Yihui, household minister, and Yilun, attendant who transmits straight.

units.zh: 武穆裴皇后諱惠昭，河東聞喜人也。
units.en: Empress Wumu Pei Huizhao came from Wenxi in Hedong commandery.
units.literal: Empress Wumu of the Pei clan, taboo name Huizhao, was a native of Wenxi in Hedong.

units.zh: 祖朴之，給事中。
units.en: Her grandfather Pei Puzhi had been a palace attendant.
units.literal: Her grandfather Puzhi was a palace attendant.

units.zh: 父璣之，左軍參軍。
units.en: Her father Pei Jizhi had been a left-army aide.
units.literal: Her father Jizhi was a left-army aide.

units.zh: 后少與豫章王妃庾氏為娣姒，庾氏勤女工，奉事太祖、昭后恭謹不倦，后不能及，故不為舅姑所重，世祖家好亦薄焉。
units.en: In youth she was sisters-in-law with Lady Yu, consort of the Prince of Yuzhang; Yu worked diligently at women's crafts and served the Grand Ancestor and Empress Zhao with tireless reverence. The empress could not match her, so her husband's parents did not value her, and Shizong's regard for the household was slight as well.
units.literal: In youth the empress was sisters-in-law with Lady Yu of the Prince of Yuzhang; Yu diligently practiced women's crafts and served the Grand Ancestor and Empress Zhao with tireless reverence—the empress could not match her, so she was not valued by her husband's parents, and Shizong's regard for the household was likewise slight.

units.zh: 性剛嚴，竟陵王子良妃袁氏布衣時有過，后加訓罰。
units.en: She was stern and strict by nature; when Yuan, consort of Prince of Jingling Ziliang, blundered while still a commoner, the empress rebuked and punished her.
units.literal: By nature stern and strict; when Yuan, consort of Prince of Jingling Ziliang, erred while still a commoner, the empress added reproof and punishment.

units.zh: 昇明三年，為齊世子妃。
units.en: In Shengming year 3 she became consort to the Qi heir apparent.
units.literal: In the third year of Shengming she became consort to the Qi heir apparent.

units.zh: 建元元年，為皇太子妃。
units.en: In the first year of Jianyuan she became consort to the crown prince.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan she became consort to the crown prince.

units.zh: 三年，后薨。
units.en: In year 3 the empress died.
units.literal: In the third year the empress died.

units.zh: 諡穆妃，葬休安陵。
units.en: She was posthumously titled Consort Mu and buried at Xiu'an Mausoleum.
units.literal: She was given the posthumous title Consort Mu and buried at Xiu'an Mausoleum.

units.zh: 世祖即位，追尊皇后。
units.en: When Shizong acceded she was posthumously honored as empress.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne she was posthumously honored as empress.

units.zh: 贈璣之金紫光祿大夫，后母檀氏餘杭廣昌鄉元君。
units.en: Pei Jizhi was made household minister with the purple-gold seal, and the empress's mother, née Tan, Village Lady of Guangchang in Yuhang.
units.literal: Jizhi was given the post of household minister with the purple-gold seal; the empress's mother, the Tan clan, was made Village Lady of Guangchang in Yuhang.

units.zh: 舊顯陽、昭陽二殿，太后、皇后所居也。
units.en: The Xianyang and Zhaoyang halls had long been the residences of empress dowager and empress.
units.literal: Formerly the Xianyang and Zhaoyang halls were where the empress dowager and empress dwelt.

units.zh: 永明中無太后、皇后，羊貴嬪居昭陽殿西，范貴妃居昭陽殿東，寵姬荀昭華居鳳華柏殿。
units.en: In the Yongming era there was no empress dowager or empress: Noble Consort Yang lived west of Zhaoyang Hall, Honored Consort Fan to the east, and the favored Xun Zhaohua in the Phoenix Splendor Cypress Hall.
units.literal: In Yongming there was neither empress dowager nor empress; Noble Consort Yang dwelt west of Zhaoyang Hall, Honored Consort Fan east of Zhaoyang Hall, and the favored lady Xun Zhaohua in the Phoenix Splendor Cypress Hall.

units.zh: 宮內御所居壽昌畫殿南閣，置白鷺鼓吹二部；
units.en: In the south gallery of the Shouchang Painted Hall, the emperor's inner quarters, two companies of egret-reed pipes were stationed;
units.literal: At the south gallery of the Shouchang Painted Hall, where the emperor dwelt within the palace, two companies of egret-reed pipes were installed;

units.zh: 乾光殿東西頭，置鍾磬兩廂：皆宴樂處也。
units.en: at the east and west ends of Qianguang Hall, bell and stone galleries on either flank—all were halls for feasting and music.
units.literal: at the east and west ends of Qianguang Hall, bell and chime galleries on either side: all were places for feasting and music.

units.zh: 上數遊幸諸苑囿，載宮人從後車，宮內深隱，不聞端門鼓漏聲，置鍾於景陽樓上，宮人聞鍾聲，早起裝飾，至今此鍾唯應五鼓及三鼓也。
units.en: The emperor often toured the royal parks with palace women in the train behind his carriage. Deep inside the palace the drum and clepsydra at the Duan Gate could not be heard, so a bell was hung on Jingyang Tower. At its stroke the women rose early to dress—to this day it sounds only at the fifth watch and the third.
units.literal: The emperor often toured the parks and enclosures, carrying palace women in the rear carriage. Deep within the palace one did not hear the drum and water-clock at the Duan Gate; a bell was set on Jingyang Tower. When palace women heard the bell they rose early to dress and adorn themselves—to this day that bell answers only the fifth watch and the third watch.

units.zh: 車駕數幸琅邪城，宮人常從，早發至湖北埭，雞始鳴。
units.en: The court often went to Langya walled town, palace women in attendance. They left at first light and reached Hubei landing at the first cockcrow.
units.literal: The imperial carriage often visited Langya walled town; palace women regularly followed. They set out early and reached Hubei ferry landing when the cock first crowed.

units.zh: 吳郡韓藺英，婦人有文辭。
units.en: Han Linying of Wu commandery was a woman of literary gifts.
units.literal: Han Linying of Wu commandery was a woman of literary talent.

units.zh: 宋孝武世，獻中興賦，被賞入宮。
units.en: Under Emperor Xiaowu of Song she submitted the "Rhapsody on Restoration" and, rewarded, was admitted to the palace.
units.literal: In the age of Emperor Xiaowu of Song she presented the "Zhongxing Rhapsody" and, prized, was brought into the palace.

units.zh: 宋明帝世，用爲宮中職僚。
units.en: Under Emperor Ming of Song she served on the palace staff.
units.literal: In the age of Emperor Ming of Song she was employed as a palace staff officer.

units.zh: 世祖以爲博士，教六宮書學，以其年老多識，呼爲「韓公」。
units.en: Shizong appointed her erudite to instruct the six palaces in writing and learning; in her great age and wide knowledge they called her "Lord Han."
units.literal: Shizong made her a erudite to teach the six palaces calligraphy and learning; because she was old and knew much, they called her "Lord Han."

units.zh: 文安王皇后諱寶明，琅邪臨沂人也。
units.en: Empress Wen'an Wang Baoming came from Linyi in Langya commandery.
units.literal: Empress Wen'an of the Wang clan, taboo name Baoming, was a native of Linyi in Langya.

units.zh: 祖韶之，吳興太守。
units.en: Her grandfather Wang Shaozhi had been administrator of Wuxing.
units.literal: Her grandfather Shaozhi was administrator of Wuxing.

units.zh: 父曄之，太宰祭酒。
units.en: Her father Wang Yezhi had been libationer to the grand minister of ceremonies.
units.literal: Her father Yezhi was libationer of the grand minister of ceremonies.

units.zh: 宋世，太祖為文惠太子納后，桂陽賊至，太祖在新亭，傳言已沒，宅復為人所抄掠，文惠太子、竟陵王子良奉穆后、庾妃及后挺身送后兄昺之家，事平乃出。
units.en: In the Song era the Grand Ancestor took her in marriage for Crown Prince Wenhui. When the Guiyang rebels came, the Grand Ancestor was at Xinting; rumor said he had perished, and the residence was plundered again. Crown Prince Wenhui and Prince of Jingling Ziliang, escorting Empress Mu, Lady Yu, and the empress, risked themselves to take them to the empress's brother Bing's house; when order was restored they came out.
units.literal: In the Song age the Grand Ancestor received the empress in marriage for Crown Prince Wenhui. When the Guiyang rebels arrived, the Grand Ancestor was at Xinting; rumor spread that he had perished, and the residence was again plundered. Crown Prince Wenhui and Prince of Jingling Ziliang, escorting Empress Mu, Lady Yu, and the empress, braved danger to deliver them to the empress's brother Bing's house; when the affair was settled they emerged.

units.zh: 建元元年，為南郡王妃。
units.en: In the first year of Jianyuan she became consort to the Prince of Nan commandery.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan she became consort to the Prince of Nan commandery.

units.zh: 四年，為皇太子妃，無寵。
units.en: In year 4 she became consort to the crown prince, without favor.
units.literal: In the fourth year she became consort to the crown prince, without favor.

units.zh: 太子為宮人製新麗衣裳及首飾，而后牀帷陳設故舊，釵鑷十餘枚。
units.en: The crown prince had new splendid garments and ornaments made for palace women, while the empress's bed curtains and furnishings stayed old, with only a dozen or so hairpins and tweezers.
units.literal: The crown prince had new splendid garments and hair ornaments made for palace women, while the empress's bed curtains and furnishings remained old, with a dozen or so hairpins and tweezers.

units.zh: 永明十一年，為皇太孫太妃。
units.en: In Yongming year 11 she became grand consort to the imperial grandson's heir.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongming she became grand consort to the imperial grandson's heir.

units.zh: 鬱林即位，尊為皇太后，稱宣德宮。
units.en: When Yulin acceded she was honored as empress dowager, styled Xuande Palace.
units.literal: When Yulin took the throne she was honored as empress dowager, styled Xuande Palace.

units.zh: 贈后父金紫光祿大夫，母桓氏豐安縣君。
units.en: Her father was made household minister with the purple-gold seal, and her mother, née Huan, County Lady of Feng'an.
units.literal: Her father was given the post of household minister with the purple-gold seal; her mother, the Huan clan, was made County Lady of Feng'an.

units.zh: 其年十二月，備法駕謁太廟。
units.en: That year, in the twelfth month, with full imperial equipage she visited the Great Temple.
units.literal: That year, in the twelfth month, with full imperial equipage she paid homage at the Great Temple.

units.zh: 高宗即位，出居鄱陽王故第，為宣德宮。
units.en: When Gaozong acceded she moved to the former residence of the Prince of Poyang, styled Xuande Palace.
units.literal: When Gaozong took the throne she moved out to the former residence of the Prince of Poyang, styled Xuande Palace.

units.zh: 永元三年，梁王定京邑，迎后入宮稱制，至禪位。
units.en: In Yongyuan year 3 the Prince of Liang secured the capital, welcomed the empress into the palace to rule in regency, and held power until the abdication.
units.literal: In the third year of Yongyuan the Prince of Liang secured the capital; he welcomed the empress into the palace to hold regency, until the abdication of the throne.

units.zh: 天監十一年，薨，年五十八。
units.en: In Tianjian year 11 she died, aged fifty-eight.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianjian she died, aged fifty-eight.

units.zh: 葬崇安陵。
units.en: She was buried at Chong'an Mausoleum.
units.literal: She was buried at Chong'an Mausoleum.

units.zh: 諡曰安后。
units.en: She was posthumously titled Empress An.
units.literal: Her posthumous title was Empress An.

units.zh: 兄晃義興太守。
units.en: Her elder brother Huang was administrator of Yixing.
units.literal: Her older brother Huang was administrator of Yixing.

units.zh: 鬱林王何妃名婧英，廬江灊人，撫軍將軍戢之女也。
units.en: Consort He Jingying of Prince Yulin came from Qian in Lujiang commandery and was the daughter of General Who Pacifies the Army He Ji.
units.literal: Consort He of Prince Yulin, personal name Jingying, was a native of Qian in Lujiang and the daughter of General Who Pacifies the Army He Ji.

units.zh: 永明二年，納爲南郡王妃。
units.en: In Yongming year 2 she entered the household as consort to the Prince of Nan commandery.
units.literal: Yongming year 2: she was received as consort to the Prince of Nan commandery.

units.zh: 十一年，爲皇太孫妃。
units.en: In year 11 she became consort to the heir apparent of the imperial grandson.
units.literal: Year 11: she became consort to the heir apparent of the imperial grandson.

units.zh: 鬱林王卽位，爲皇后。
units.en: When Prince Yulin acceded, she was made empress.
units.literal: When Prince Yulin took the throne, she became empress.

units.zh: 嫡母劉氏爲高昌縣都鄉君，所生母宋氏，爲餘杭廣昌鄉君。
units.en: Her foster mother, née Liu, was made Chief Village Lady of Duxiang in Gaochang county; her birth mother, née Song, Village Lady of Guangchang in Yuhang.
units.literal: Her formal mother, the Liu clan, was made Chief Village Lady of Duxiang in Gaochang county; her birth mother, the Song clan, Village Lady of Guangchang in Yuhang.

units.zh: 將拜，鏡在牀無故墮地。
units.en: On the eve of her investiture a mirror on the bed fell to the floor without cause.
units.literal: As the investiture approached, a mirror on the bed fell to the floor for no reason.

units.zh: 其冬，與太后同日謁太廟。
units.en: That winter she and the empress dowager visited the Great Temple on the same day.
units.literal: That winter she and the empress dowager on the same day paid homage at the Great Temple.

units.zh: 后稟性淫亂，爲妃時，便與外人姦通。
units.en: The empress was wanton by nature; even as a princess consort she took lovers from outside the palace.
units.literal: The empress was by nature licentious; even as a consort she had illicit relations with outsiders.

units.zh: 在後宮，復通帝左右楊珉之，與同寢處如伉儷。
units.en: In the inner quarters she took up with Yang Minzhi, a favorite at the emperor's side, and they slept and lived together like husband and wife.
units.literal: In the inner palace she again had relations with Yang Minzhi, an attendant at the emperor's side, sharing bed and board like man and wife.

units.zh: 珉之又與帝相愛褻，故帝恣之。
units.en: Minzhi was likewise intimate with the emperor, and the emperor let them have their way.
units.literal: Minzhi was also on intimate terms with the emperor, so the emperor indulged them.

units.zh: 迎后親戚入宮，賞賜人百數十萬。
units.en: She summoned the empress's kin into the palace and lavished rewards running into hundreds of thousands.
units.literal: She brought the empress's kinsmen into the palace and bestowed rewards in the hundreds of thousands.

units.zh: 以世祖耀靈殿處后家屬。
units.en: Shizu's Yaoling Hall was set aside to lodge the empress's kin.
units.literal: Shizu's Yaoling Hall was given over to house the empress's family.

units.zh: 帝被廢，后貶爲王妃。
units.en: When the emperor was deposed, the empress was reduced to princess consort.
units.literal: When the emperor was deposed, the empress was demoted to princess consort.

units.zh: 海陵王王妃名韶明，琅邪臨沂人，太常慈女也。
units.en: The consort of the prince of Hailing, named Shaoming, came from Linyi in Langya commandery and was the daughter of Grandee of Ceremonies Ci.
units.literal: The consort of the Prince of Hailing was named Shaoming, a native of Linyi in Langya, daughter of Grandee of Ceremonies Ci.

units.zh: 永明八年，納爲臨汝公夫人。
units.en: In the eighth year of Yongming she was married to the lord of Linru as his lady.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Yongming she was taken as Lady of the Lord of Linru.

units.zh: 鬱林卽位，爲新安王妃。
units.en: When Yulin took the throne, she became princess consort of Xin'an.
units.literal: When Yulin acceded, she became princess consort of Xin'an.

units.zh: 延興元年，爲皇后。
units.en: In the first year of Yanxing she was raised to empress.
units.literal: In the first year of Yanxing she was made empress.

units.zh: 其年，降爲海陵王妃。
units.en: That same year she was reduced to consort of the prince of Hailing.
units.literal: That same year she was demoted to consort of the Prince of Hailing.

units.zh: 明敬劉皇后諱惠端，彭城人，光祿大夫道弘孫也。
units.en: Empress Mingjing Liu, whose personal name was Huiduan, came from Pengcheng and was the granddaughter of Household Minister Liu Daohong.
units.literal: Empress Mingjing Liu, personal name Huiduan, was a native of Pengcheng and granddaughter of Household Minister Daohong.

units.zh: 太祖爲高宗納之。
units.en: The Grand Progenitor arranged her marriage to Gaozong.
units.literal: The Grand Progenitor secured her in marriage for Gaozong.

units.zh: 建元三年，除西昌侯夫人。
units.en: In the third year of Jianyuan she was made lady to the marquis of Xichang.
units.literal: In the third year of Jianyuan she was invested as Lady of the Marquis of Xichang.

units.zh: 永明七年，卒，葬江乘縣張山。
units.en: In the seventh year of Yongming she died and was buried at Zhang Mountain in Jiangcheng county.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Yongming she died and was buried at Zhang Mountain in Jiangcheng county.

units.zh: 延興元年，贈宣城王妃。
units.en: In the first year of Yanxing she was posthumously titled princess consort of Xuancheng.
units.literal: In the first year of Yanxing she was posthumously given the title Princess Consort of Xuancheng.

units.zh: 高宗卽位，追尊爲敬皇后。
units.en: When Gaozong acceded, she was posthumously honored as Empress Jing.
units.literal: When Gaozong took the throne, she was posthumously honored as Empress Jing.

units.zh: 贈父通直郎景猷金紫光祿大夫，母王氏平陽鄉君。
units.en: Her father Jingyou, a regular attendant in the transmission office, was posthumously made household minister with the golden seal and purple cord; her mother, Lady Wang, was made lady of Pingyang township.
units.literal: Her father Jingyou, General of Transmission who was Regular, was posthumously made Household Minister with the Golden Seal and Purple Cord; her mother, Lady Wang, was made Lady of Pingyang township.

units.zh: 永泰元年，高宗崩，改葬，祔于興安陵。
units.en: In the first year of Yongtai, when Gaozong died, she was reinterred and laid beside him in Xing'an Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongtai, when Gaozong died, she was reburied and consigned to Xing'an Mausoleum.

units.zh: 東昏褚皇后名令璩，河南陽翟人，太常澄女也。
units.en: Empress Chu of Dong Hun, named Lingque, came from Yangdi in Henan commandery and was the daughter of Grandee of Ceremonies Chu Cheng.
units.literal: Empress Chu of Dong Hun, named Lingque, was a native of Yangdi in Henan and daughter of Grandee of Ceremonies Cheng.

units.zh: 建武二年，納爲皇太子妃。
units.en: In the second year of Jianwu she was married to the crown prince as his consort.
units.literal: In the second year of Jianwu she was taken as the crown prince's consort.

units.zh: 明年，謁敬后廟。
units.en: The following year she worshipped at Empress Jing's temple.
units.literal: The following year she paid worship at Empress Jing's temple.

units.zh: 東昏卽位，爲皇后。
units.en: When Dong Hun took the throne, she was made empress.
units.literal: When Dong Hun acceded, she was made empress.

units.zh: 帝寵潘妃，后不被遇。
units.en: The emperor doted on Consort Pan, and the empress went unvisited.
units.literal: The emperor favored Consort Pan; the empress received no attention.

units.zh: 黃淑儀生太子誦，東昏廢，竝爲庶人。
units.en: Honored Lady Huang had borne Crown Prince Song; when Dong Hun was deposed, mother and son were both reduced to commoners.
units.literal: Honored Lady Huang bore Crown Prince Song; when Dong Hun was deposed, both became commoners.

units.zh: 和帝王皇后名蕣華，琅邪臨沂人，太尉儉孫也。
units.en: Empress Wang of Emperor He, named Shunhua, came from Linyi in Langya commandery and was the granddaughter of Grand Commandant Wang Jian.
units.literal: Empress Wang of Emperor He, named Shunhua, was a native of Linyi in Langya and granddaughter of Grand Commandant Jian.

units.zh: 初爲隨王妃。
units.en: At first she was princess consort of Sui.
units.literal: At first she was princess consort of Sui.

units.zh: 中興元年，爲皇后。
units.en: In the first year of Zhongxing she was raised to empress.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing she was made empress.

units.zh: 帝禪位，后降爲妃。
units.en: When the emperor yielded the throne, the empress was reduced to consort.
units.literal: When the emperor abdicated the throne, the empress was demoted to consort.

units.zh: 史臣曰：后妃之德，著自風謠，義起閨房，而道化天下。
units.en: The historian writes: The virtue of empresses and consorts shines in folk song; their righteousness begins behind closed doors and spreads until it reshapes the world.
units.literal: The historian writes: The virtue of empresses and consorts is recorded in folk song; righteousness rises in the inner chamber and transforms the realm beneath Heaven.

units.zh: 繰盆獻種，罔非耕織，佩管晨興，與子同事，可以光熙閫業，作儷公侯。
units.en: They reel the cocoon basin and offer seed—nothing but spinning and weaving; they gird the reed and rise at dawn, working beside their sons—thus the inner household glows and they stand as equals to dukes and marquises.
units.literal: Reeling the cocoon-tray and offering seed—all is spinning and weaving; girding the shuttle-gauge and rising at dawn, sharing toil with their sons—they can brighten the household estate and stand as peers to dukes and marquises.

units.zh: 孝、昭二后，竝有賢明之訓，不得母臨萬國。
units.en: The Xiao and Gao empresses both bore wise instruction, yet never ruled the realm as mothers of the state.
units.literal: Empresses Xiao and Gao both possessed wise and clarifying instruction, yet could not mother the myriad domains.

units.zh: 寶命方昌，椒庭虛位，有婦人焉，空慕周興，禎符顯瑞，徒萃徽名。
units.en: While the sacred mandate was rising, the empress's courts stood vacant; some women only dreamed of a Zhou restoration—bright omens and lucky signs heaped up nothing but hollow fame.
units.literal: While the precious mandate flourished anew, the pepper courts stood empty; certain women only yearned in vain for the Zhou revival—auspicious tokens and bright omens gathered nothing but empty glory.

units.zh: 若使掖作同休，陰教遠燮，則馬、鄧風流，復存乎此。
units.en: Had the side palaces rested in one accord and the women's teaching steadied the realm from within, the elegance of the Ma and Deng empresses might have returned here.
units.literal: Had the lateral palaces shared one repose and the inner teaching harmonized the realm from afar, the grace of Ma and Deng might have lived here again.

units.zh: 太祖創命，宮禁貶約，毀宋明之紫極，革前代之踰奢，衣不文繡，色無紅采，永巷貧空，有同素室。
units.en: At the Grand Progenitor's founding, the palace was pared to austerity: he razed Emperor Ming of Song's Purple Ultimate Hall and cut the extravagance of earlier reigns—garments without figured embroidery, colors without red; the long alleys were empty and poor as plain chambers.
units.literal: When the Grand Progenitor founded the dynasty, palace bounds were stripped back: he destroyed Emperor Ming of Song's Purple Ultimate, reformed past dynasties' excess; robes bore no brocade patterns, colors no scarlet; the long alleys were poor and bare as undecorated rooms.

units.zh: 世祖嗣位，運藉休平，壽昌前興，鳳華晚搆，香柏文檉，花梁繡柱，雕金鏤寶，頗用房帷，趙瑟吳趨，承閑奏曲，歲費傍恩，足使充牣，事由私蓄，無損國儲。
units.en: When Shizu succeeded, the age rested on peace—Shouchang rose early, Fenghua late; fragrant cypress and patterned rafters, painted beams and embroidered pillars, carved gold and set gems crowded the curtained halls; Zhao zithers and Wu songs filled idle hours; yearly outlays from side revenues overflowed the vaults—paid from private stores, never touching the state coffers.
units.literal: When Shizu succeeded, fortune rode on peaceful times—Shouchang built early, Fenghua raised late; fragrant cypress and patterned beams, floral rafters and embroidered pillars, carved gold and inset jewels filled the curtained chambers; Zhao harps and Wu airs were played in leisure; yearly spending from ancillary favor was enough to overflow the stores—all from private hoards, never draining the state treasury.

units.zh: 高宗仗數矯情，外行儉陋，內奉宮業，曾莫云改。
units.en: Gaozong trusted omens and played at austerity—plain and mean in public, yet he kept the palace estate as before and never breathed a word of reform.
units.literal: Gaozong leaned on numerology and feigned restraint: outwardly frugal and plain, inwardly he sustained palace industry and never spoke of change.

units.zh: 東昏喪道，侈風大扇，銷糜海內，以贍浮飾，哲婦傾城，同符殷、夏。
units.en: Dong Hun abandoned the Way; luxury blazed across the land; he melted the empire to pay for idle display—wise women toppled cities, in the manner of Yin and Xia.
units.literal: Dong Hun lost the Way; extravagance swept wide; he melted the realm to feed vain ornament—sagacious women overturned cities, matching Yin and Xia alike.

units.zh: 嗚呼！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 所以垂戒於方來也。
units.en: So a warning is set down for ages still to come.
units.literal: Thus a warning is left to generations yet to come.

units.zh: 贊曰：宣武孝則，識有先知。
units.en: In praise: Empress Xuanxiao, filial and correct—she saw what was coming before it came.
units.literal: In praise: The Filial Norm of Xuanxiao—her discernment held foresight.

units.zh: 高昭誕武，世載母儀。
units.en: Gao Zhao bore the martial emperor; her motherly measure passed down the line.
units.literal: Gao Zhao bore the Martial heir; for generations she carried the motherly pattern.

units.zh: 裴穆儲閫，位亦從隳。
units.en: Reverent Pei kept the inner palace—and her station fell with its fall.
units.literal: Pei the Reverent stored the inner palace—and rank followed ruin.

units.zh: 明敬典冊，配在宗枝。
units.en: Mingjing's rites and writ—joined to the imperial house.
units.literal: Mingjing's canon and seals—matched to the imperial branch.

units.zh: 秋宮亦遽，軒景前虧。
units.en: The autumn palace too was cut short; the chariot sun waned before its season.
units.literal: The autumn palace too was sudden; the carriage-sun dimmed before its time.

units.zh: 文安廢主，百憂已離，中興秉制，揖讓弘規。
units.en: Wen'an and the deposed sovereign, grief already behind them; at Zhongxing she took the seals, then yielded the throne in great ceremony.
units.literal: Wen'an's deposed lord, a hundred cares already gone; at Zhongxing she held the regalia, yielding the throne in grand courtesy.

units.literal: [1] Endnote marker.
